 Quality & Food Safety Director 
 About the job 
Are you a strategic thinker with deep expertise in Quality and Food Safety? 
Do you thrive in complex, high-stakes environments where your decisions shape global standards and protect consumer trust? 
We are seeking a visionary Director of Standards, Risk Anticipation & Crisis to lead our proactive risk management and standards development across the Specialised Nutrition (SN) category. 
At Danone we are committed to our mission of "bringing health, through food to as many people as possible". 
At the same time we are working together to make sure that our brands offer benefits for people, communities and the planet. If you join Danone, you will be part of one of the largest Certified B Corps™ in the world. Being B Corp means to be part of a select movement of companies verified to be meeting the highest standards of social and environmental criteria and using business as a force for good. 
One of our divisions within Danone, is Specialised Nutrition where we develop science-based nutritional solutions that support health and growth from early life through adulthood, helping people with specific nutritional needs live healthier lives. At Danone we believe nutrition can make a profound difference to health.
